body.title: Build and Optimize a High Frequency Trading Backtester
body.aiReason: Requires a test project before hiring (potential unpaid work) – red flag outweighs skill fit.
body.description:
I have been building a backtester inside of Claude and have done some light work of my own and there are 2 gaps:
1. Reliability of output from any of the LLMs - between drift and memory issues it is a QA challenge
2. The ability to handle variable outcomes. The LLMs can in theory help with testing thousands of combinations, however - without reliable and consistent outputs that is not useful. Standard coded variable testing 1 at a time can produce reliable results, however thousands of variations may need to be tested - making this a very time consuming process.
I need someone that can resolve the 2 core issues - reliability and variability testing.
To be considered for this role - which will start PT and could lead to full time work with upside in the business it will be used for - we will have to go through a test project to determine the fit.
